01 Services

From a door handle to a whole new bathroom.

Whatever your property needs — inside or out — you can count on A Plus Handyman to see it through, start to finish.

Fancy a fresh coat of paint in your living room, or new colors throughout your home? Give us your specification and we take care of the rest — with a finish that's clean and mess-free.

Quote my painting job →

Residential or commercial, no siding project is too big or too small. Cladding work can include waterproofing, soundproofing and insulation options to suit the property.

Quote my siding job →

From low water pressure to clogged drains, we cover it. Don't DIY a serious issue — that's what we're here for.

If certain rooms are looking old, worn or tired, it might be time to freshen things up. From a new bathroom installation to a full room refresh, we plan it with you and keep you updated at every stage.
